split.kind: fixed spatial cells in initial source working coordinates

applied_model.sampling: inverse matrix; plus the cubic B-spline correction in `local_field`, evaluated at the working-grid reference position

residual_definition: symmetric forward/backward transfer error of applied model
basis: all held-out matcher correspondences; not external ground truth
check_point_rule: held-out correspondence within max(3 reference px, 3 robust sigma) of the median displacement of its 10 nearest held-out neighbours, displacements taken against the coarse model; the exported model is not consulted
